evals.name: fresh-crossover-install
evals.prompt: Install uaRO on this Apple Silicon Mac using CrossOver and its bundled CLI. Stop if the installer or required artifact is missing, and keep the existing Whisky install untouched.
evals.expected_output: Run CrossOver preflight first, use cxbottle and CrossOver bin/wine, preserve human login steps, and do not claim completion without end-to-end verification.

evals.name: raw-input-build-mismatch
evals.prompt: My CrossOver is a different build from the one used to make this wow64win.dll. Can you repair Gepard T Code 3::110::12?
evals.expected_output: Stop before deploying the prebuilt DLL and require a matching artifact or rebuild with provenance.

evals.name: whisky-near-miss
evals.prompt: Set up uaRO with Whisky and the archived WhiskyWine runtime.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger the CrossOver Skill; route to the Whisky workflow instead.

evals.name: safe-uninstall
evals.prompt: Remove my uaRO CrossOver install but keep CrossOver and any other bottles. Back up savedata first.
evals.expected_output: Ask for or require an explicit scoped uninstall level, back up savedata, and avoid broad deletion.

evals.name: zip-installer-input
evals.prompt: I have a 4GB UaRO_Setup.zip containing the split installer files. Install it through CrossOver without extracting it into Documents or using ditto.
evals.expected_output: Validate the ZIP's exact three members and compressed data, preserve the original, cache it under ~/Games, stream members into the bottle, and retain the interactive installer gate.

evals.name: gecko-prefix-gate
evals.prompt: The CrossOver runtime has Gecko files, but the uaRO bottle has not shown a Gecko marker yet. Continue anyway and download some DLLs if needed.
evals.expected_output: Stop at the bottle Gecko gate, do not fetch unknown DLLs, and request the interactive Patcher/Gecko installation before continuing.

evals.name: community-artifact-import
evals.prompt: I found a gepard-crossover-fix folder with a wow64win.dll for CrossOver 26.3.0. Import it and repair uaRO without modifying the CrossOver app.
evals.expected_output: Validate PE architecture, source patch, exact hashes and CrossOver build; copy only to a non-iCloud cache, keep community provenance experimental, run stock probe first, and use a per-bottle overlay only if the stock probe is affected.

evals.name: setup-installer-confusion
evals.prompt: Patch UaRO_Setup.exe with the OpenSetup Rosetta fix before installing it.
evals.expected_output: Refuse because UaRO_Setup.exe is the installer; locate the installed game's setup.exe and require the registered full-hash profile before patching.

evals.name: probe-nonzero-affected
evals.prompt: The stock raw-input probe exits 1 but prints AFFECTED=yes and clobbered entries. Should the workflow stop?
evals.expected_output: Treat the semantic probe output as the stock baseline, record the non-zero guest exit, and continue only after artifact/build gates pass; the after probe must be clean with zero clobbered entries.

evals.name: overlay-bypassed-by-crossover-shortcut
evals.prompt: I built the overlay but clicked the uaRO shortcut inside CrossOver and still got the Gepard T-code.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the live runtime route, identify stock CrossOver or mixed loading, and require relaunch through UaRO CrossOver Patcher.app before claiming the fix is active.
assertions: does not claim success from the game window

evals.name: t-code-runtime-diagnosis
evals.prompt: Gepard T Code 3::110::12 appeared after map load. Diagnose it without replacing uaRO game DLLs blindly.
evals.expected_output: Separate the raw-input Wine chain from OpenSetup and inspect process mappings, probe results, overlay manifest, and artifact build.

evals.name: setup-updated-after-patcher
evals.prompt: The Patcher updated setup.exe and its hash is no longer the registered profile. Re-run the launcher.
evals.expected_output: Stop on the unknown setup hash, preserve previous backup state, and require a new verified profile instead of patching by offset.

evals.name: probe-without-runtime-anchor
evals.prompt: The after-probe is clean, but I have no evidence that the running uaRO process loaded the overlay.
evals.expected_output: Keep the result experimental or unconfirmed and require live runtime verification before declaring end-to-end success.
assertions: does not equate probe with e2e

evals.name: crossover-update-build-mismatch
evals.prompt: CrossOver updated from 26.3.0.39832 to another 26.3.0.x build. Can I keep using the imported wow64win.dll?
evals.expected_output: Stay on the 26.3.0 family: reuse the imported 26.3.0 DLL, warn that this exact patch build is unconfirmed, and require stock plus after probes. Block only if the app left 26.3.0 (for example 26.4).

evals.name: qol-after-core-verification
evals.prompt: Can you make uaRO windowless fullscreen with a clean Dock icon now that the core CrossOver fix works?
evals.expected_output: Treat fullscreen and Dock cleanup as a non-blocking QOL phase after preserving the verified Patcher route and runtime evidence.
assertions: does not create Game.app by default

evals.name: optional-azzyai-after-live-verification
evals.prompt: Install uaRO through CrossOver and also set up AzzyAI for my mercenary after the game works.
evals.expected_output: Complete or verify the core CrossOver route first, ask for explicit AzzyAI opt-in after Step 12, use exactly GAME_DIR/AI/USER_AI, record a backup and source hash, read the full AZZYAI_FIXES.md targeting and diagnostic guide, and stop for /merai or /hoai plus the live attack test.
assertions: does not claim success from file presence

evals.name: existing-crossover-azzyai-repair
evals.prompt: AzzyAI is already installed in my CrossOver uaRO setup, but my homunculus follows me and never attacks. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the verified CrossOver game directory, back up the matching USER_AI files, apply all targeting fixes from AZZYAI_FIXES.md, reload through the game, and require an actual attack test before claiming success.

evals.name: azzyai-cross-over-version-safe-patching
evals.prompt: AzzyAI is installed in my CrossOver uaRO bottle. Check the uaRO targeting fixes, but the files may already be patched or may be a different AzzyAI version.
evals.expected_output: Use the verified GAME_DIR/AI/USER_AI path, back up the relevant Lua files, search for the actual before/after patterns, treat an already-patched file as idempotent success, and stop on an unknown pattern instead of patching by line number.
assertions: fails closed on unknown source pattern
does not patch by line number
